SELECT o.id, o.order_no, o.user_id, o.user_name, o.user_phone, o.receiver_name, o.receiver_phone, o.receiver_address, o.total_amount, o.discount_amount, o.actual_amount, o.freight, o.pay_status, o.order_status, o.remark, o.create_time, o.update_time, (SELECT goods_name FROM tbl_order_item WHERE order_id = o.id LIMIT 1) AS goods_name, (SELECT goods_image FROM tbl_order_item WHERE order_id = o.id LIMIT 1) AS goods_image, (SELECT price FROM tbl_order_item WHERE order_id = o.id LIMIT 1) AS price, (SELECT quantity FROM tbl_order_item WHERE order_id = o.id LIMIT 1) AS quantity, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tbl_order_item WHERE order_id = o.id) AS item_count FROM tbl_order_info o
AND o.order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.orderNo}, '%')
AND ( o.user_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.keyword}, '%') OR o.user_phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.keyword}, '%') OR o.receiver_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.keyword}, '%') OR o.receiver_phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.keyword}, '%') )
AND o.user_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.userName}, '%')
AND o.user_phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.userPhone}, '%')
AND o.receiver_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.receiverName}, '%')
AND o.receiver_phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.receiverPhone}, '%')
AND o.order_status = #{param.orderStatus}
AND o.create_time >= #{param.startTime}
AND o.create_time <= CONCAT(#{param.endTime}, ' 23:59:59')
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tbl_order_item oi WHERE oi.order_id = o.id AND oi.goods_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.goodsName}, '%') )
ORDER BY o.id DESC
